movers.quantum: Rs 903.01 cr incl GST; ~2.1% of mcap
movers.headline: takes a **Rs 903,00,68,492 including GST Letter of Award from SJVN Thermal** to build a permanent siding and aerial connection for the 1,320 MW Buxar thermal power project in Bihar, over 36 months
wins an **NHAI work order of Rs 108,68,07,575** to act as user fee collection agency at the Chillakallu toll plaza on NH-65 in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, for one year

movers.quantum: Rs 105.43 cr; ~28.6% of mcap; only Rs 5.00 cr of it equity
movers.headline: completes its **Rs 1,05,42,80,536 resolution-plan funding of Sharan Hospitality**, which becomes a wholly owned subsidiary; Rs 71.15 crore of it is debentures and Rs 29.28 crore an inter-corporate deposit

movers.quantum: Rs 80.77 cr excl taxes, the filer's own aggregate; ~1.3% of mcap
movers.headline: books **orders it aggregates at Rs 80.77 crore** — a Rs 43.52 crore letter of intent from DXDC Chennai and a Rs 37.25 crore Micron Semiconductor order, both for power distribution

movers.quantum: RPEL 80% / TRLK 20%; 3,50,000 MTPA planned; consideration not disclosed
movers.headline: approves an **80:20 joint venture with TRL Krosaki Refractories** for a 3,50,000 MTPA silica ramming mass plant in Odisha, each party contributing capital in the JV ratio

order_wins: **Rail Vikas Nigam** — a **Letter of Award from SJVN Thermal, a wholly owned subsidiary of SJVN, of Rs 903,00,68,492 including GST** _(~2.1% of mcap)_, to build a permanent siding and aerial connection from the plant boundary to Chausa and Pawani Kamarpur at Buxar Phase-III for the 1,320 MW thermal project, over 36 months.

**Rail Vikas Nigam** — a **second award the same day, Rs 404,88,18,738 including GST from East Coast Railway** _(~0.9% of mcap)_, for roadbed, bridges, RUBs, buildings, ballast, P-Way linking and electrification between Khurda Road and Gangadharpur, over 30 months.

**B.R.Goyal Infrastructure** — a **work order from NHAI, accepted value Rs 108,68,07,575** _(~23.6% of mcap)_, engaging it by e-tender as user fee collection agency at the Chillakallu (Km 205.025) toll plaza on the Hyderabad–Vijayawada section of NH-65, for one year.

**Urban Enviro Waste Management** — a work order from **Akola Municipal Corporation for door-to-door municipal solid waste collection and transport to the Bhod site, Rs 219,09,12,500 over five years** and extendable by two, to start within 15 days of the order.

**Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders** — a purchase order from **Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission for an AI-based comprehensive Infrasecure project at five substations, INR 117,99,71,564.90 including GST at 18%**, over 24 months _(~0.2% of mcap)_.

**Marine Electricals (India)** — **orders the company aggregates at Rs 80.77 crore excluding taxes** _(~1.3% of mcap)_: a Rs 43.52 crore letter of intent from DXDC Chennai and a Rs 37.25 crore supply order from Micron Semiconductor Technology India, each over four to five months.

**NLC India** — wholly owned **NLC India Renewables emerges successful bidder in Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam's tariff-based competitive bidding for a 275 MW / 550 MWh standalone battery storage system** in Gujarat and has received the Letter of Intent. No project value is stated.

**Jhaveri Credits & Capital** — a **Letter of Award received 3 September from the New & Renewable Energy Development Corporation of Andhra Pradesh** for grid-connected rooftop solar at government institutions under RESCO mode, priced only in per-unit tariffs of **Rs 3.98 to Rs 4.28** with no contract value stated.

**TechEra Engineering (India)** — two purchase orders from **TechEra Engineering USA Inc, USD 70,259.28 for engineering and manufacturing development services and USD 84,000 for V8 engine pallet assemblies**, each over one month. It holds 10% of that customer and calls it a related party.

**Dhruv Consultancy Services** — a **Letter of Award from National Highway Logistics Management for a 15-year lease to develop, operate and maintain wayside amenities on NH-361 at Chakur-Loha, Nanded**. The consideration runs the other way: Dhruv pays Rs 6,48,000 of annual lease rent.

**Happy Square Outsourcing (White Force)** — a **third extension of its July-2024 Bharat Dynamics manpower-supply work order, approximately Rs 56.64 lakh inclusive of taxes**, over four months on unchanged terms; the order was previously extended in June 2026.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Globesecure Technologies** — its board approves **raising up to Rs 49.00 crore by a rights issue** to shareholders on a record date yet to be fixed, approves the Draft Letter of Offer for in-principle approval and constitutes a Rights Issue Committee to set the price, ratio and record date.

**Kerala Ayurveda** — its board approves a **preferential issue of 7,20,000 shares at Rs 190.37, Rs 13,70,66,400**, to promoter-group lender Katra Holding, partially adjusting an existing unsecured loan of Rs 26,41,20,000; subject to shareholder approval at the 28 September AGM.

**Tunwal E-Motors** — its board approves issuing **up to 34,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 30, aggregating up to Rs 10,20,00,000**, to identified promoters for cash on a preferential basis, alongside a final dividend of 10 paise and a new statutory auditor.

**Advance Multitech** — files a **revised outcome of its 1 September board meeting**, correcting the preferential issue to up to 1,00,00,000 warrants at Rs 40 each from 4,00,00,000 at Rs 10, and the authorised-capital increase to Rs 15 crore from Rs 45 crore; both subject to shareholder approval.

**Manas Polymers and Energies** — confirms its **rights issue ratio at 2 new shares for every 1 held**, on terms its board approved on 25 August, and warns that the market lot will consequently double from 1,600 shares to 3,200.
equity_allotments: **Iris Clothings** — allots **77,08,183 equity shares at Rs 41.67, Rs 32,12,00,000**, to Harsh Vardhan Sarda and Pooja Sarda **for consideration other than cash** in a share swap, taking them from 0.03% and 0.49% to 1.97% and 2.42%; NSE in-principle approval was granted on 25 August.

**Fabtech Cleanrooms** — allots **3,80,711 warrants at Rs 394, Rs 15,00,00,134**, to four named non-promoters led by Amer Aasif Khan, on receipt of Rs 3,75,00,033.50 as the 25% upfront; there is no change in paid-up capital until conversion.

**MIC Electronics** — allots **5,68,73,418 equity shares of Rs 2 preferentially to the Neo selling shareholders for consideration other than cash**, under the EGM approval of 29 April 2026 and in furtherance of its intimations of 30 March, 29 April and 26 August.

**Veranda Learning Solutions** — converts **1,55,763 warrants into equity at Rs 321 for Goodday Enterprises LLP**, on Rs 3,74,99,942.25 of balance consideration, taking the total for those warrants to **Rs 4,99,99,923** on the filing's own arithmetic; the warrants were allotted on 3 March 2025.

**Lippi Systems** — allots **65,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 56.84, Rs 36,94,60,000**, to five members of the Dholu promoter family, on Rs 9,23,65,000 received as the 25% upfront; conversion requires Rs 27,70,95,000 more within 18 months.
**iStreet Network** — converts **3,50,000 warrants into 3,50,000 equity shares of Rs 4** on payment of the Rs 4.50 balance per warrant, **Rs 15,75,000**, completing the Rs 6 issue price.

**Z-Tech (India)** — receives **NSE listing and trading approval effective 7 September for 1,07,000 shares issued on warrant conversion**, taking paid-up capital to Rs 14,87,14,480 from Rs 14,76,44,480.

**Ganesh Infraworld** — receives **NSE listing approval for 10,49,600 equity shares of Rs 5 allotted on conversion of preferentially issued warrants**, distinctive numbers 42721398 to 43770997, in furtherance of its 7 July intimation.

**Vaishali Pharma** — receives **NSE in-principle approval to list 45,37,865 equity shares of Rs 2 already allotted on a preferential basis**, distinctive numbers 130462131 to 134999995; listing follows depository confirmation.
m_and_a: **SIS** — buys a further **12,14,731 equity shares of Updater Services for Rs 28.54 crore in cash**, completed 4 September, taking its holding to 66,97,313 shares or exactly **10.00%** of Updater's paid-up capital; it calls the purchase an investment-policy decision, not a related-party transaction.

**One Global Service Provider** — executes share purchase agreements for **51% each of Matrix Labs Diagnocare and Matrix Labs, Rs 35,97,81,800 and Rs 3,56,35,320**, discharged entirely in 7,14,680 of its own shares at Rs 553 — **Rs 39,54,17,120 of non-cash consideration** to Suresh and Nithya S.

**Globesecure Technologies** — the same outcome approves **three acquisitions**: 75% of ANA Cyber Forensic by subscribing to fresh equity, 51% of Optimistic Technology Solutions, and a 51% partnership interest in Crescent Technologies. No consideration is stated for any of the three.

**Sanginita Chemicals (now Agastya Energy and Infrastructure)** — sells its **Chhatral Phase IV plot at Kalol, Gandhinagar and the assets on it to AAG Capital Holdings for Rs 12.54 crore**; the annexure records the buyer as a related party — a director's relative is a director there — on an arm's-length basis.

**Gretex Industries** — its board approves **disposing of three subsidiaries to Harlalka family members**, the 75.30% of material subsidiary Gretex RS Properties LLP going to Sumeet and Sashi Harlalka for up to Rs 6.45 crore, all subject to a postal ballot; the same outcome postpones its own equity fundraise.

**AJC Jewel Manufacturers** — its board approves buying **80% of AJC Jewel Manufacturers (FZC), Sharjah for Rs 9,59,96,946**, discharged entirely in up to 5,67,492 of its own shares at Rs 169.16 to a promoter-group transferor. The release is datelined 2 September and was carried in that day's digest.

**Cyient** — **completes the acquisition of 100% of Tao Digital Solutions Inc of the USA on a fully diluted basis**, further to its announcement of 30 May 2026. The intimation states no consideration.

**Autofurnish** — **completes the acquisition of 55% of Chhariot EMob**, an electric two-wheeler and EV-battery business, **for cash at face value**, with its own promoters taking the other 45% — which the annexure records as making it a related-party transaction.

**Greenlam Industries** — agrees to buy **20,65,001 shares, 26% of Bhadla Minigrid Solar 4**, a newly incorporated SPV for a **captive** power plant, to satisfy the electricity-law captive-consumption test. No consideration is stated and the target has yet to begin operations.

**Elgi Equipments** — wholly owned Elgi Compressors USA **relinquishes its entire stake in JV Gentex Air Solutions to partner James Gery Naico in exchange for release of exclusivity in certain Texas counties** — no cash consideration. The JV contributed USD 7,735 of profit, 0.02% of consolidated PAT.

**Thyrocare Technologies** — API Holdings reports that the **NCLT-sanctioned amalgamation of Docon Technologies into API became effective 3 September**, so Docon's 8,12,00,000 shares — **51.02% of Thyrocare** — vested in API by operation of law, with no change in aggregate promoter holding.

**Lodha Developers** — issues **NCLT-directed notices convening shareholder and secured-creditor meetings on the merger by absorption of Roselabs Finance and National Standard (India) into itself**, under the tribunal's order of 6 August. No consideration or share-exchange ratio is stated in the intimation.
capex_core: **Sterlite Technologies** — its board approves **capacity addition of about 50% over existing installed optical-fibre-cable capacity at an investment of ~Rs 3,000 crore by end-FY29**, funded from internal accruals and/or debt; existing utilisation is ~70% and the existing capacity is withheld as commercially sensitive.

**CIE Automotive India** — subscribes to **69,40,000 rights shares of wholly owned CIE Hosur for Rs 120,75,60,000** _(~0.8% of mcap)_; CIE Hosur, which turned over INR 1,751.95 million to December 2025, remains wholly owned, so the money stays inside the group.

**CG Power and Industrial Solutions** — **rolls out the first transformer from its new greenfield 45,000 MVA plant at MPIDC Sehore, Madhya Pradesh**, the project its board approved on 28 January 2025 and for which MPIDC allotted land in August 2025. No project cost is stated.

**Fujiyama Power Systems** — subscribes to **833 compulsorily convertible debentures of associate Zayo Energy at Rs 60,093 each, Rs 5,00,57,469**, under a CCD subscription agreement signed 4 September.
business_updates: **Results season** — 9 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Brigade Enterprises** — launches **Brigade Barcelona at Neopolis, Hyderabad on 4.04 acres bought outright, 650+ homes, with an estimated revenue potential of over Rs 2,700 crore** _(~11.9% of mcap)_ — a development pipeline figure over the project's life, not a booked sale.

**Brahmaputra Infrastructure** — puts its **consolidated order book including joint operations at approximately Rs 1,600 crore as at 31 August**, with over Rs 2,000 crore of bids under evaluation due within six weeks and an expectation of reaching ~Rs 2,500 crore by FY27-end on 20–25% EBITDA margins.
**Lupin** — receives **US FDA approval for its abbreviated new drug application for Modafinil tablets USP in 100 mg and 200 mg strengths**. The release states no market size or revenue expectation.

**Angel One** — its August business update puts the **client base at 39.56 million, up 17.8% year on year**, gross client acquisition at 0.57 million and the average client funding book at Rs 74.21 billion, up 40.2% year on year, over 21 trading days.
**Eicher Motors** — Royal Enfield **launches the Himalayan 440 with a new 443cc long-stroke engine, six-speed gearbox and upgraded frame**, ten years after the original Himalayan.
**Balaji Telefilms** — **partners with YouTube to launch five exclusive premium shows**. The release states no investment, revenue split or other commercial term.

**Acutaas Chemicals** — **inaugurates a pilot plant at Unit 1, Sachin, Surat** for new-product trials and validation, including a dedicated OEB-4 containment area for highly potent intermediates and HPAPIs. No cost is stated.
**NHC Foods** — **launches Kap's Delight Recipe Mixes**, a range of convenience recipe mixes. The release states no capacity, investment or revenue figure.
distress_risk: **SVP Global Textiles** — the **NCLT Mumbai admits Canara Bank's Section 7 application against subsidiary Shrivallabh Pittie Enterprises on 3 September, starting insolvency on a default of Rs 75,93,98,670.05** dated 13 March 2023.

**Future Enterprises** (under CIRP) — the committee of creditors, on e-voting concluded 2 September, **selects Orissa Metaliks as Successful Resolution Applicant for the Cluster 3 assets with 93.26% of the voting share**, on a plan dated 27 April read with a 10 June addendum.

**Aries Agro** — files an appeal with the GST Appellate Authority at Mazgaon against a **FY2018-19 input-tax-credit demand of Rs 3,96,45,090 including interest and penalty**, raised on inputs bought from vendors whose registrations were later cancelled retrospectively.

**ZF Steering Gear India** — the **Delhi Income Tax Tribunal, by its order of 3 September, allows its Section 80-IA and 80-IB deductions for assessment years 1995-96 to 2004-05** across ten appeals, making the company eligible for a refund it does not quantify.

**Carraro India** — receives an **order-in-original from the Commissioner of Customs at Nhava Sheva confirming the classification and differential IGST proposed in a show-cause notice of 1 September 2025**. The intimation states no amount.

**United Breweries** — obtains a **favourable order from the Bombay High Court, Aurangabad bench, in the revenue's appeal against the Commissioner of Central Excise and Central GST, Aurangabad**. No amount is stated in the intimation.

**Prestige Estates Projects** — clarifies a **4 September Moneycontrol report on a MahaRERA Appellate Tribunal order of 25 August concerning Turf View, Mahalaxmi**, brought by three homebuyers, which it describes as ordinary-course proceedings with no material impact.

**Talwalkars Better Value Fitness** — files the **NCLAT Principal Bench order of 3 September in Company Appeal (AT) (Insolvency) No. 710 of 2026** as an update on its liquidation. The cached text stops before the order's operative part.

**Kalahridhaan Trendz** (under CIRP) — its resolution professional **files the list of creditors as at 3 September with the NCLT Ahmedabad**, under the insolvency commenced by that tribunal's order of 14 August.

**Roselabs Finance** — convenes the **NCLT-directed meeting of its equity shareholders on the merger by absorption of itself and National Standard (India) into Lodha Developers**, under the tribunal's order of 6 August.

**Teerth Gopicon** (under CIRP) — its interim resolution professional files an **interlocutory application with the NCLT on 3 September**; the cached pages hold only the tribunal's e-filing receipt, not the application's substance.
other_notable: **Aarti Surfactants** — a credit-rating change: having **transitioned its rating agency from CARE to CRISIL**, it is rated **CRISIL A-/Stable, which its own filing calls a revision from CARE BBB+/Stable**, on Rs 200 crore of long-term bank facilities.
**Shankesh Jewellers** — a credit-rating change: CRISIL **revises its outlook on Rs 90 crore of long-term bank facilities to Positive from Stable** and reaffirms the rating at BBB.

**Innovators Facade Systems** — a credit-rating change the other way: Infomerics **revises its outlook to Stable from Positive** while reaffirming IVR BBB and A3+, on facilities enhanced to Rs 252.60 crore from Rs 249.43 crore.

**PVR INOX** — publishes a **corrigendum to its 1 September public announcement for a tender-offer buyback of up to 20,68,965 equity shares at Rs 1,450 a share**, carried in Business Standard, Hindi and Navshakti on 4 September.
**Advanced Enzyme Technologies** — buys back **55,332 shares on 4 September at an average Rs 297.93**, taking the total bought back under its open-market programme to 10,28,788 shares.

**Great Eastern Shipping** — opens its buyback, purchasing **1,33,517 shares on 4 September at an average Rs 1,360.99** — the first day's buying under the Rs 900 crore programme its board approved on 27 August.

**Tips Music** — publishes the **public announcement for its open-market buyback of Re 1 shares** on 4 September, following the e-voting results of its 31 August annual general meeting. The announcement's size and price are not in the pages cached.
**Man Infraconstruction** — sends **electronic intimation of its open-market buyback to shareholders on record as at the public-announcement date**. The letter states neither the size nor the price.

**CEAT** — writes to shareholders whose **FY2025-26 dividend could not be credited for invalid bank or demat details**, urging a KYC update to avoid the unpaid dividend and the underlying shares being transferred to the IEPF.

**Chandni Machines Ltd** — Chandni Machines Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 08/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve sub-division / split of existing ....
